title: datasource: the credential refusals send a code author (defineDatasource) to a Setup form that cannot edit a code-defined datasource; name a binding path a code author can follow
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filing gate: ② a gap measured beside a ruled card. Triage's contract review of PR #27656 (#27614), comment 6504200509, second should-fix ("follow-up, shared with the three sibling refusals; not owed by this PR"). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

**Business reason.** An author who writes a datasource in code (`defineDatasource`) with an inline password is refused, and the refusal tells them to bind a secret on the Setup → Datasources form or to use "a handle the secret store minted". A code-defined datasource is read-only to the admin service, so the form cannot bind a secret onto it, and nothing says how a code author mints a `sys_secret:` handle. The author has a correct refusal and no path they can follow.

## Measured (by the review, on PR #27656 head `68b2eec2`)

- The four credential refusals prescribe the same two routes in the same words: `INLINE_CREDENTIAL_REFUSED`, `URL_EMBEDDED_CREDENTIAL_REFUSED`, `refusedInlineCredentialKey().describe()` and the two strings #27656 adds (`packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts`). The first two were maintainer-ruled in this shape (#7990, #8082).
- A code-defined datasource is read-only to the admin service (`datasource-admin-service.ts:15`, `:656-658`, `:702`).

## Wanted

- A measured answer to "how does a code author bind a credential to a `defineDatasource`?" (for example a CLI or API that mints a `sys_secret:` handle, an env-backed resolver, or binding at deploy), then one prescription that names it, shared by all four refusals and `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx` / `external-datasources.mdx`. If the answer changes a ruled prescription (#7990, #8082), it goes to the maintainer as a decision card first.

## Dedupe

Open issues searched for "defineDatasource credentialsRef code-defined read-only secret": none the same.
